description: A thirteen-minute awareness episode for IT service desk staff. On an authorised exercise at Quayholt Insurance, a fictional company, you first play the attacker: research what's public, ring the service desk as a locked-out manager, and watch an account worn down by sign-in prompts. Then you swap seats and work the service desk queue a call like it lands in. Only the queue is scored, and ringing back a real caller never costs you anything.
